title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot of $$z$$ vs $$y$$. Notice the pattern of the data points. Does it resemble a linear, quadratic, or another type of relationship?

title: Identifying the Pattern
text: The scatterplot shows a curve that appears to be quadratic. This suggests that $$y$$ might be related to $$z$$ in a quadratic manner.

title: Formulating the Relationship
text: If the relationship is quadratic, consider the form $$y=\left(mz+b\right)^2$$. This matches the pattern seen in the scatterplot.
